name: Podvorye Smoked Sausage
description: Sliced sausage. A seasoned, stuffed, and smoked meat sausage, thinly sliced and served as is. A signature dish of Podvorye Restaurant, and a reliable choice no one at the table would turn down.

suspicious.name: Suspicious Podvorye Smoked Sausage
suspicious.description: Sliced sausage. The pieces are unevenly cut, with a few still stuck together. When picked up, they looked just like a string of weathered vines blackened with smoke...
suspicious.effect: Restores 8% of Max HP and an additional 800 HP to the selected character.

normal.name: Podvorye Smoked Sausage
normal.description: Sliced sausage. A seasoned, stuffed, and smoked meat sausage, thinly sliced and served as is. A signature dish of Podvorye Restaurant, and a reliable choice no one at the table would turn down.
normal.effect: Restores 9% of Max HP and an additional 1,000 HP to the selected character.

delicious.name: Delicious Podvorye Smoked Sausage
delicious.description: Sliced sausage. The firm texture sets the rhythm while smoky, savory flavors carry the melody, dancing across the palate in a perfectly harmonious duet. No wonder this is always the first plate to empty.
delicious.effect: Restores 10% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.
